NewsArticle.Title: Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: 04.18 11:44 a.m. PDT Dark Ages server was down for 30 seconds for scheduled maintenance. Dark Ages again warned players and rebooted to complete maintenance at 12:48 p.m PDT. We fixed the temporary errors: infinite player-killing time on Sgrios summoner, erratic damage, and restored automatic political office list. On 04/19 at 6 a.m. PDT, we fix the temporary political range error. Once service returns, please immediately report what seem to be errors: [www.darkages.com/contact](http://www.darkages.com/contact) Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
